pose: HANGING STRAIGHT LEG RAISE top: overhand grip on real grounded rack pull-up bar, elbows fully straight, torso vertical, BOTH legs straight together lifted forward to HORIZONTAL90deg hip flexion. Knees extended, feet together, no bending or swinging. Side three-quarter makes L silhouette obvious. Head neutral faces same direction as chest, whole bar mounts/rack feet and body visible.

CAPTAIN'S CHAIR KNEE RAISE. Real recognizable vertical knee raise station: two parallel horizontal forearm pads at waist/chest height attached to grounded steel uprights, small vertical handles at front ends, modest vertical back pad behind athlete. Forearms lie fully on pads, hands wrap handles, shoulders depressed. BOTH knees bent and lifted toward chest, feet off floor, back supported. Front three-quarter clearly shows elbows/pads contacts, stable broad bases and two symmetric handles; no invented mechanisms. Head straight ahead.

LYING LEG RAISE midrange. Athlete supine with head, shoulders and lower back on dark mat. Arms straight by torso palms down. Both knees straight, legs together elevated45deg toward ceiling, heels well off floor. Neutral neck looking ceiling, no twisted face. SIDE profile clearly shows hip flexion and grounded torso, unlike reverse crunch pelvis stays down.

equipment: single real ab wheel and mat
pose: AB WHEEL ROLLOUT extended midrange: both knees on mat and lower legs behind; BOTH hands grasp short handles projecting from either side of ONE ordinary black ab wheel on floor. Wheel directly ahead of shoulders. Arms long reaching forward overhead relative to torso, head/torso/hips/thighs form controlled long line from knees, no lumbar sag. Side three-quarter shows circular wheel tire contacts floor and realistic axle, all hands/feet visible.

BODY SAW retracted phase: forearm plank with elbows on floor slightly IN FRONT of shoulders as straight body glides BACKWARD. BOTH toes on separate small black floor sliders, knees straight, hips in same line with shoulders/heels. Hands relaxed parallel on floor, no wheel or bands. Side view shows long lever, sliders and grounded forearms. Head aligned looking floor, no hip pike.

DEAD BUG. Supine, lower back and head grounded. RIGHT arm extended overhead hovering just above floor, LEFT leg extended straight low above floor. LEFT arm points vertically toward ceiling, RIGHT hip and knee bent90deg tabletop. All four limbs clearly separate with contralateral pattern anatomically correct. Elevated side-three-quarter camera makes floor clearance and opposite arm/leg pairing readable. Face toward ceiling, no neck rotation.

HOLLOW BODY HOLD: athlete balances on lower back/pelvis, shoulder blades raised slightly, BOTH straight arms reaching overhead alongside ears and both straight legs together lifted15deg above floor. Ribs down, posterior pelvic tilt, no lumbar arch. Whole body forms shallow smooth banana with hands and feet off floor, chin gently tucked. Full SIDE profile to show airborne limbs and lumbar contact. No equipment.

V-UP contracted peak. Body balanced on buttocks, torso lifted45deg above floor and BOTH straight legs lifted45deg creating a V at hips. Both arms extend forward toward shins/toes, hands separate, knees remain straight. Upper torso modestly curled, neck aligned gaze toward toes. Side profile clearly separates V shape from flat hollow hold, all hands and feet visible.

TOE TOUCH abdominal crunch: supine lower back and hips grounded, BOTH legs straight vertically up90deg at hips, soles toward ceiling. Shoulder blades lifted, both arms reach upward toward toes with hands stopping near shins. Neutral neck softly tucked, eyes toward feet. Side-three-quarter shows VERTICAL legs and grounded pelvis, not seated V-up. Entire body, no external weights.

COPENHAGEN SIDE PLANK isometric hold: left forearm grounded with elbow under shoulder, right TOP leg straight with inner right ankle resting on sturdy43cm flat bench. Left BOTTOM leg bent at knee90deg, held floating beneath pelvis, not touching floor. Hips high in straight shoulder-hip-top-ankle line, free hand on hip. Side-front full view shows clear elevated ankle support and bent hovering bottom leg. Head aligned with chest gaze forward, proper grounded steel bench.
